info.name: GitHub Remove Custom Label from Self-hosted Runner for Repository

params.name: owner
params.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: repo
params.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.

params.name: runner_id
params.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of a self-hosted runner's custom label.

items.docs:
Remove a custom label from a self-hosted runner configured
in a repository. Returns the remaining labels from the runner.

This endpoint returns a `404 Not Found` status if the custom label is not
present on the runner.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the repository to use this endpoint.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
